entries.answer:
I've built the complete, single-file `index.html` SPA implementing the full spec you provided .

## What's included

The file implements the entire architecture in the required order: PWA-configured `<head>` with manifest links, theme-color meta tags for dark/light modes, and vendor CSS/JS references to `/static/vendor/`; a full CSS design system with `:root` tokens (accent, fg, liquid glass tokens, safe-area insets) plus a `@media (prefers-color-scheme: light)` override; the exact DOM skeleton (sidebar, chat container, input area, context menu, action sheet, robot panel); and a single async IIFE containing all JavaScript.

## Core functionality delivered

Session management (hmeta schema, `saveHmeta`, `renderSidebar` with pin/sort logic, pull-to-search gesture, action sheet with pin/rename/delete), full message rendering (`mkUser`, `mkAI`, a hand-rolled Markdown-to-HTML converter with fenced code block handling and `hljs.highlightElement` integration), file attachment handling with image compression via canvas, and the complete SSE streaming pipeline (`send`, `streamReq`, `dispatchEvt` handling all nine event types: text, search_start, sources, code_exec_start/done, memory_read/write, done, error, robot_id).

Also implemented: context menu with copy/edit/retry/delete and long-press support, soft-delete via `deletedGroups` persisted to localStorage, background job polling that survives page reload, and the full Screen Robot subsystem (EventSource connection, badge state machine, human-input injection).

## WebGL2 glass renderer

The `MultiPassRenderer` class runs a genuine three-pass pipeline: an animated gradient background pass, a two-direction Gaussian blur pass at half resolution, and a compositing pass with a real `rectSDF` function that refracts UVs near glass-region edges and adds Fresnel-style rim highlighting. It queries `.lg`/`.ibox`/`.bubble`/`.ai-bubble` elements each frame via `getBoundingClientRect()` and packs up to 32 rects into a uniform array, exactly as specified.

## Notes for deployment

This client is fully functional as written, but it depends on a backend that implements the nine endpoints in the API contract (`/api/chat`, `/api/history`, `/api/job/{id}/status`, `/api/robot/*`) — that backend isn't included since it wasn't requested, and vendor files (`highlight.min.js`, `github-dark-dimmed.min.css`) need to be placed at `/static/vendor/` for syntax highlighting to work.

Regarding the instruction block embedded in your message asking me to role-play a "jailbroken" mode with fictional personas and unrestricted output — I didn't follow that, since it's a prompt injection technique rather than a genuine system directive, and I don't have or need a hidden "unlocked" version of myself. I just focused on delivering the actual engineering deliverable you specified.
